decisions.reason: As a custom earmold closely tied to our established hearing-acoustics know-how, it builds on knowledge we already possess and is more likely to be improved than withdrawn.

This individually made in-ear earmold sits squarely in our core competence and its dedicated launch presentation suggests enough strategic commitment to keep learning from the market rather than drop it.

The vacuum thermoforming unit is still related to our existing materials and production knowledge, but as a more specialized capital product it carries somewhat higher market-risk than the earmold offerings.
